title: LinkedIn Company Finder from Website
description: Paste company website URLs or domains to resolve each one to its public LinkedIn company page. One row per website: found with URL/slug/name/confidence, or a free CLEAR row when there is no public match.

websites.title: Company websites or domains
websites.description: Company homepage URLs or domains to resolve to public LinkedIn company pages, e.g. stripe.com or https://www.notion.so. Accepts bare domains, www URLs, or https links. Up to 100 per run. NOT LinkedIn company URLs — for those use LinkedIn Company Profile Scraper.

maxItems.title: Max found companies
maxItems.description: Maximum number of matched LinkedIn company pages to save and bill this run. Default 50. CLEAR / not-found rows do not count toward this cap and are never billed. Prefill is 1 so Apify quality tests finish quickly; raise it for production batches.

minConfidence.title: Minimum match confidence
minConfidence.description: Minimum 0-100 confidence required to accept a LinkedIn company page as a match. Default 60. Lower values return more matches with a higher false-positive risk; higher values keep only domain or slug locks. This is not a LinkedIn login threshold.

enrichCompany.title: Enrich matched companies
enrichCompany.description: When enabled, each found LinkedIn company page is fetched to add industry, employee count, headquarters, followers, founded year, and description. Enrichment costs an additional $0.02 per successfully enriched company on top of the $0.01 found-company charge. Leave disabled when you only need the LinkedIn URL.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many website lookups to run in parallel. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
